title: Migration from the countryside to the cities
goal: Follow the millions of people who left the countryside for the cities, and say what they stopped doing and what they kept doing with dejar de.

items: I can explain why people left the countryside for the cities.
I can name big cities that grew very fast.
I can describe the problems of the fast-growing cities.
I can say how migrants helped each other.
I can say what people stopped doing and what they kept doing with dejar de.
